<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Zoophonic Communication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5415) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 65

**Prerequisites**
[zoophonia muse](/Muses.aspx?ID=9)

</column>

---

Your studies have expanded your ability to parley and negotiate into the animal realm. You can [Request](/Actions.aspx?ID=2393) from [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) using [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) instead of [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) as though you shared a language, although this gives you no special ability to understand their responses. You can also use Performance instead of [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) to [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400).
name: Zoophonic Communication
